title: End-to-End Architecture: Present, Defend, Revise
objective: Produce a self-scoped architecture packet with at least three ADRs tied to stated NFRs, defend it live against one changed constraint, and supersede the ADR that constraint invalidated.
whyThisMatters: Single decisions can be locally right and globally incoherent. This closing task asks you to compose a system — NFRs, decisions, a quantitative model, a diagnostic story — and revise one piece when a constraint changes, without rewriting the packet from scratch. That is the job this curriculum was training.
evidence: An architecture packet containing an NFR sheet, at least three ADRs each tracing to a stated NFR, one quantitative model (capacity, SLO, or cost), one system diagram, and a short diagnostic story naming the signals that would distinguish two failures
Defense-session notes naming the changed constraint and the specific question that most challenged the original packet
A superseding or amended ADR that addresses the changed constraint without silently deleting the originals, plus a side-by-side note of what the constraint invalidated
acceptanceCriteria: The packet contains at least three ADRs, and each ADR names the NFR or constraint it responds to.
The diagnostic story names two failures and the specific signal that would distinguish them, using the same vocabulary as a prior observability or SLO artifact.

Defense notes name one changed constraint and one question the apprentice could not fully answer live; a second ADR marks the invalidated decision as superseded or amended rather than replacing it silently.
